Debugging & Direct IP / macOS Notes

1. Direct IP Mode: On the Send tab, enter your other device's Local IP (shown in the top badge on Receive) and click Connect IP. HackDrop immediately performs a TLS POST /Discover handshake on port 8770 (or 8771).

2. Running on macOS: Use ./hackdrop-darwin-arm64 (Apple Silicon M1–M4) or ./hackdrop-darwin-amd64 (Intel Mac/Hackintosh). If macOS sharingd is holding port 8770, HackDrop automatically binds port 8771.
